title: Update AGENTS merge workflow to require PRs
description: Revise AGENTS.md session-completion guidance so completed work is pushed to a feature branch and merged to main through a pull request, rather than direct pushes to main. Preserve the requirement that work is not stranded locally and that tracker state is synced.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md clearly states that main is updated via PR, gives the branch/push/PR workflow, retains quality gates and beads sync expectations, and removes/directly qualifies the old direct-main push wording.
close_reason: AGENTS.md session-completion workflow now requires feature branch push and PR targeting main, and explicitly forbids direct pushes to main. Verification: git diff --check passed and rg confirmed PR workflow wording.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
